shinjuku-foreign.title: Shinjuku City: Living Information for Foreign Residents
shinjuku-foreign.note: Shinjuku's official website made for foreign residents: daily life, garbage, health, disaster, taxes, Japanese classes, and consultation, with Japanese, English, Chinese, and Korean versions.

tabunka-plaza.title: Shinjuku Multicultural Plaza
tabunka-plaza.note: Free multilingual consultation desk and Japanese classes, minutes from Okubo: the first stop for daily-life questions when you don't know where to go.

shinjuku-city.title: Shinjuku City Official Website
shinjuku-city.note: The ward office for Shinjuku / Okubo residents: resident registration, health insurance, tax, and daily-life procedures all happen here (site mainly in Japanese).

shinjuku-garbage.title: Shinjuku City: Recyclable Resources and Garbage
shinjuku-garbage.note: Shinjuku's official garbage and recycling rules for foreign residents: how to separate, which day to put out, and multilingual guides.

iryou-net.title: Medical Information Net (NAVII)
iryou-net.organization: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
iryou-net.note: Japan's official nationwide search for hospitals and clinics: find facilities near you and check which languages they can handle.

tokyo-metro.title: Tokyo Metropolitan Government
tokyo-metro.note: Tokyo-wide living information and multilingual support services from the metropolitan government: useful when a question goes beyond Shinjuku.

tokyo-bousai.title: Tokyo Disaster Prevention (Tokyo Bousai)
tokyo-bousai.note: Tokyo's official disaster site: preparedness guides, evacuation information, and emergency updates, with multilingual pages.

tokyo-fire.title: Tokyo Fire Department: 119 / #7119
tokyo-fire.note: The official authority for 119 (fire / ambulance). Also runs #7119, the 24-hour line for advice when you are not sure it is an emergency.

isa.title: Immigration Services Agency of Japan
isa.note: The official authority for residence cards, visas, and status of residence: the only place to confirm any immigration procedure.

fresc.title: FRESC: Foreign Residents Support Center
fresc.note: National support desks: immigration, work, legal, human rights: gathered in one building near Shinjuku, with interpretation available.

nta.title: National Tax Agency
nta.note: The official authority for national taxes: income tax, filing, and English-language tax guides.

nenkin.title: Japan Pension Service
nenkin.note: The official body for national pension enrollment, payments, and exemptions: with an international section in English.

tokyo-opendata.title: Tokyo Open Data Catalog
tokyo-opendata.note: Public datasets (facilities, consultation desks, disaster info) that MINFO plans to connect for ward-by-ward expansion across Tokyo.

shinjuku-public-housing-recruitment.title: Shinjuku City: Ward-run rental housing recruitment
shinjuku-public-housing-recruitment.note: Official information on Shinjuku ward-run rental housing recruitment and eligibility. Check the current notice because requirements vary.

shinjuku-flood-guidance.title: Shinjuku City: Flood and water-disaster guidance
shinjuku-flood-guidance.note: Official Shinjuku guidance for flood and water-disaster preparation.

shinjuku-weather-information.title: Shinjuku City: Weather information
shinjuku-weather-information.note: Official weather and disaster-information links for Shinjuku residents.

regasu-japanese-classes.title: Shinjuku Cultural Center Foundation: Japanese classes
regasu-japanese-classes.note: Official class information for non-native speakers learning daily-life Japanese in Shinjuku. Availability can change.

tokyo-muslim-travelers-guide.title: Tokyo Muslim Travelers' Guide
tokyo-muslim-travelers-guide.note: A Tokyo guide to prayer facilities, halal and Muslim-friendly dining, and other facilities. Confirm details directly with each facility.
